scope: Exploratory generation-only candidate selection, no held-out predictive evaluation
hypothesis: Choosing the lowest fraction of adjacent onset leaps above an octave from four fixed candidates reduces abrupt leaps but may reduce melodic variety.
control: first successful candidate in each group
selection: lowest fraction abs adjacent onset pitch interval >12 semitones, ties earliest offset
missing: report all blocked candidates and empty groups; never silently regenerate
generator: unchanged cycle6 frozen selected position model
interpretation: Reduced selected objective is expected by construction. Inspect diversity tradeoffs; neither this objective nor other structural features establish musical appeal.
human_evaluation: Not performed; opt-in existing listening protocol remains separate
